current_compact_upload.detail: Native-half OpenImageIO decode, CPU float32 Raster widening, then half upload and GPU widening.

direct_float32.detail: OpenImageIO float32 avoids NumPy astype, but the archived RTX playback comparison fell from 10.586 to 6.090 fps after compact upload was removed.

retain_half_until_gpu.detail: Raster currently requires float32 pixels, so moving the widening off the decode thread needs a lazy compact-source representation with explicit CPU-consumer widening.

verdict: The direct-float decode winner is unsafe for playback. Preserve the existing compact upload until a lazy half source can retain CPU fallback semantics and receive a fresh before/after playback comparison.
